reproduction.pairController:
import os,subprocess,pathlib,json
for trial in [1,2,3]:
    for build in (['baseline','candidate'] if trial%2 else ['candidate','baseline']):
        directory=f'/tmp/canoli-f14-paired-{build}-{trial}'
        env=dict(os.environ,CANOLI_TYPING_URL='http://127.0.0.1:4183/' if build=='baseline' else 'http://127.0.0.1:4173/',CANOLI_TYPING_OUTPUT=directory)
        with open(directory+'.log','w') as log:
            subprocess.run(['node','scripts/benchmark-text-input.mjs'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
        report=json.loads(pathlib.Path(directory+'/report.json').read_text())
        print(json.dumps({'build':build,'trial':trial,'results':{r['fixture']['id']:round(r['p95Ms'],2) for r in report['reports']}}),flush=True)
